name: 090-scale-15mp-catalog
description: 15MP 300dpi-class catalog page: the tier-policy boundary fixture; single-pass downscale 0.87x keeps every glyph tier legible.
expected_text:
HARBORLIGHT INSTRUMENTS
Precision Components Catalog, Edition 14
Section 3: Optical Assemblies
All housings are machined from 6061-T6 aluminium and anodized in matte black. Threads follow the RMS standard unless
noted otherwise in the item description. Every assembly ships with a test card recording the measured transmitted
wavefront and the coating run code.
OA-2210 Collimator, 25 mm aperture, serial range LN-4821 to LN-5140
OA-2214 Beam expander 3x, fused silica, coated 400-700 nm, code BX-31
OA-2290 Kinematic mount, 80 TPI adjusters, lockable, code KM-80
Ordering and Lead Times
Orders received before 14:00 UTC ship the same business day from the Kiel works. Custom coatings add nine working days
to any line item. Quote code QX-77 applies to universities and public research laboratories only and cannot combine with
distributor pricing.
Batch acceptance: MIL-PRF-13830B, scratch-dig 40-20 on all catalogue optics.
Interferometric flatness lambda/10 at 632.8 nm available on request per lot.
Harborlight Instruments GmbH, Werftstrasse 21, 24103 Kiel. Registered HRB 8821 KI.
VAT DE 318 442 901. Catalog data sheet HL-CAT-14-3EN. Errata via the service desk.
Section 4: Mounting Hardware
MH-410 Post holder, 40 mm bore, side-locking thumbscrew, black anodize
MH-415 Damped post, filled core, first resonance above 900 Hz measured
MH-460 Rail carrier, dovetail profile, 25 mm of travel per adjuster turn
Warranty and Returns
All items carry a three year warranty against defects in materials and workmanship. Return authorisations issue from
service desk RMA-9 within one business day of request, and advance replacements are available for any item stocked in
the Kiel or Portsmouth warehouses.
Prices exclude carriage and import duty. INCOTERMS 2020 EXW Kiel applies throughout.
This edition supersedes HL-CAT-13 in whole. The errata list is available on request.
Section 5: Cleaning and Handling
Handle coated optics by their edges with powder-free gloves and blow loose dust away with dry nitrogen before any
contact method. Use spectroscopic grade acetone on lint-free wipes, one pass per wipe surface, and never rewet a used
wipe. Store optics in their shipped membrane boxes below 60 percent relative humidity.
Technical Support
Application engineers answer at support@harborlight.example between 07:00 and 18:00 CET on working days. Include the
serial number and the coating run code from the edge engraving with any query. Calibration certificates reissue free
within three years of shipment, and out-of-warranty repairs are quoted within five working days.
